ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central fields (~80%) contrasted against low-intensity (black) peripheral boundaries and tips (~20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central area of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips, with a mottled transition zone of mixed intensities located at the fluke base near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an interior pixel angle of approximately 35 degrees; vertical depth measures approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the continuous boundary. The right distal tip shows high-amplitude jagged peaks (approximately 5-10 pixels in depth), while the left lobe shows lower-amplitude, more rounded serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the lateral tips; tips exhibit an upward (distal) orientation relative to the horizontal axis of the peduncle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (scars) detected against the low-intensity black background on the right fluke tip; smaller isolated white circular pixel groups detected on the dark margin of the left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically across the high-intensity white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma manifested as vertical rake marks on the left lobe and circular scarring (likely barnacle-related) localized on both fluke tips.
